verdicts.note: Free-standing special act; 'If accepted, the application shall be reviewed as if it had been received on or before the taxable status date' binds the assessor of the city of New Rochelle (passive voice, locality is the actor).

New matter in Tax Law 1202-aa(8): 'no assessment of additional tax shall be made after the expiration of more than three years' is a prohibition on the city of New Rochelle's tax administration, so a duty.

The quote is content of the resolution the village must file to elect the benefit ('a resolution of its governing board certifying ... that the village of Rockville Centre shall pay all past service costs'), a condition of the section 1 power; the operative cost duty is section 2 ('shall be borne by the village of Rockville Centre'); the words 'shall pay' read as duty, not neither.

Section 2 of a free-standing act: 'No such contract or lease ... shall provide for a fee simple conveyance' restricts the lease the state university trustees are authorized to make, a prohibition on them, so a duty.

Section 2: 'Any contract or lease entered into pursuant to this act ... shall provide that the real property ... shall revert to the state university of New York' requires the trustees to include a reversion term.
Section 2 of a free-standing alienation act: 'the city of New York shall dedicate the difference' in fair market value to Queens parkland acquisition or improvements, a conditional duty of the city.

Section 1 creates the district and states 'The district will operate a public library to be known as the Grinnell public library'; borderline, since 'will' is not 'shall' and the sentence sits in the establishing clause, but it reads as the district's operating mandate.
Section 4(6): 'The treasurer of the Grinnell public library district shall be custodian of all funds of the district' is an ongoing duty of the district's officer.
Section 4(6): 'No monies shall be disbursed by the treasurer of the district except after audit by the board of trustees' is a prohibition on the district treasurer, so a duty.

The quote is the effective-date and sunset clause of chapter 59 of 2010 ('shall take effect on the ninetieth day ... and shall expire [5] {{10}} years after such effective date'), an act-clause sunset sentence that imposes nothing on the city of New York; only '10' is new matter.

Tax Law 1202-aa(10) 'each enactment of such a local law may provide for the imposition of a hotel or motel tax for a period of time no longer than three years' is a duration limit on the subdivision (1) taxing power, not a separate grant; if kept, it is a cap on the city, and 'may' does not make it a new power.

The underlying power is real ('is hereby authorized to make such benefits available to officer Noz Firoz'), but the stored quote is only the subject phrase ('the village of Rockville Centre ... which previously elected to offer the optional twenty year retirement plan') and contains no operative words; requote to keep.
